I will keep all 4.5 mu in cotton this year because my land is small, I know cotton well, and after 45 years I trust the crop and management rhythm I already understand. Since I have well irrigation, I will rely on a stable cotton plan instead of taking risks. I will use improved seed because I want more even emergence and better yield stability than old saved seed. I will prepare the land with rotary tillage because it is easier for me to manage on a small area and gives a fine seedbed for sowing. I will put in a moderate fertilizer plan, not too heavy, because my field is small and I want to control cost while still feeding the crop well through the season. I will irrigate about three times, mainly around establishment, flowering, and boll setting, because cotton needs water most at those stages and I have access to a well. I will spray pesticides when pressure appears and expect about four applications over the season, because cotton usually needs active pest control to protect bolls and leaves. I am aiming for a steady yield rather than an aggressive one, so I will target about 280 kg per mu.
